items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: I'm trying to think of Robinson's first name. In fact, he sent me a letter sometime before he died.

ctx.x: Now what were the professional black teams that played in this area? What did New Orleans have the professional black teams?

Well, you had the New Orleans black pelicans named after the New Orleans white baseball team. Then you had the Morris Moore All-Stars. Then you had the Jacks Red Sox. You had quite a few. You had a fellow by the name of Robinson. I'm trying to think of Robinson, who was one of the so-called big-time chefs from New Orleans, who was a professional restaurant. I was a restaurant tour who went to New York and opened a big-time restaurant. I'm trying to think of Robinson's first name. In fact, he sent me a letter…
So that was it. Where, where, where, where the black, uh, professional games, where were they played? What were the first games?
